paper.title_en: Strong hyperbolicity of puncture-gauge formulations of gravitational theories with second order equations of motion
paper.abstract_en: We prove that the modified CCZ4 (mCCZ4) formulation, used in nonlinear puncture-gauge simulations of (d+1)-dimensional Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity and four-derivative scalar-tensor theory in four dimensions, is strongly hyperbolic for both theories at sufficiently weak coupling, provided that the gauge parameters are chosen to satisfy a cone-separation condition. The proof applies to the full principal symbol of the theories, extending previous analyses based on first-order perturbation theory about the Einstein limit. We establish strong hyperbolicity by recasting the mCCZ4 equations into a formally equivalent second-order system whose derivative structure resembles that of the modified harmonic formulation of Kovács and Reall. This allows us to adapt their covariant characteristic analysis and continuity argument, without assuming that individual eigenvalues or eigenvectors depend analytically on the coupling. We also show that standard CCZ4 in general relativity is strongly hyperbolic in puncture gauge away from two defective degeneracies.

decision.title_zh: 二阶运动方程引力理论puncture规范表述的强双曲性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，用于(d+1)维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet引力和四维四导数标量-张量理论非线性puncture规范模拟的修改CCZ4（mCCZ4）表述，在耦合足够弱的情况下对这两种理论都是强双曲的，前提是规范参数被选取为满足一个锥分离条件。该证明适用于这些理论的完整主符号，扩展了此前基于爱因斯坦极限附近一阶微扰理论的分析。我们通过将mCCZ4方程重铸为一个形式上等价的二阶系统来建立强双曲性，该系统的导数结构与Kovács和Reall的修改调和表述相似。这使我们能够改编他们的协变特征分析和连续性论证，而不假设各个本征值或本征向量解析地依赖于耦合。我们还证明，广义相对论中的标准CCZ4在puncture规范下，除两处缺陷性退化之外是强双曲的。
